central_claim: C4 remains active and unrefuted: failure-derived memory provenance may causally sustain future error beyond task difficulty and matched actionable guidance.

identification_audit.conclusion: Semantic information-equivalence, not embedding cosine, is the dominant identification weakness. R4 cannot robustly isolate provenance beyond residual actionable-content differences.

independent_confirmation_support.same_release_rescan_rule: Apply the R2 static structural qualification to all frozen WebArena parquet shards while excluding all C01 task IDs exposed by prior bridge and R2/R4 experiments.

scientific_decision.reason: The preregistered statistical support gate remains closed and the information-equivalence identification gate is not robust across blinded reviewers. No independent fresh confirmation pool or source-faithful financial execution path is currently available.

forbidden_repairs: do not add seeds to the same four R4 pairs to rescue p<0.05
do not drop or replace R4 pairs based on post-hoc verifier disagreement
do not lower the 0.15 effect floor or raise the 0.05 p threshold
do not relax the original task structural qualification after observing R4 outcomes
do not substitute a different embedding or executor and call it source-faithful financial replication
do not reinterpret identification failure as scientific counterevidence to C4
